title: External Research Watchlist → EFC Graph Target Mapping (DRAFT)
purpose: Human-curated mapping from watchlist canonical keys to EFCValidation test_ids, gap_ids, or competing-framework relations. Consumed by the external_watchlist_to_graph parser when constructing Publication→Test/Gap/Framework edges.
test_id_source: Neo4j EFCValidation nodes, 2026-04-18 snapshot (288 entries, 233 with non-null test_id)

audit_history.summary: Initial draft; 30 targets across 12 items (22 high / 7 medium / 0 low / 3 gap not_found).

Morten review round 1. (a) Re-audited all medium-confidence targets against 'can I argue equally for another test_id' test — 3 downgraded to low. (b) Added 2 better-fitting high-confidence targets for arXiv:2601.14559 (3×2pt) discovered via perturbation-scoped search. (c) Removed test dual-target on arXiv:2601.00522; kept framework kind only per Morten — added followup_required metadata for future Evaluation-node creation when ΔAIC runs. (d) Added probe_subtype annotations for DES Y6 cosmic-shear vs 3×2pt to distinguish which data stream informs each test. (e) Confirmed via KnowledgeGap search (42,874 nodes) that the three watchlist gap_ids have no graph counterpart under any label — Alt A exhausted; Alt B (dedicated ledger-update path) is next action for gap materialization.

parser_safety_contract.pre_run_check: Parser MUST refuse execution while last_verified_by_morten is null. Write a single WARN log line and exit non-zero.
parser_safety_contract.edge_status_rule: high confidence → edge.status = 'confirmed'. medium/low → edge.status = 'proposed'. Only 'confirmed' edges count in downstream dashboards and syretest queries.
parser_safety_contract.graph_status_rule: If graph_status = 'not_found', parser MUST log and SKIP — never create implicit Gap/Test nodes from this file.
parser_safety_contract.authority_rule: This file is advisory. It never overrides explicit graph facts. If a Publication already has SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS from elsewhere, parser adds INFORMS in parallel, does not replace.

confidence_scale.high: ledger_action or efc_relevance explicitly names a graph-known identifier
confidence_scale.medium: thematically clear; single plausible candidate and no equally strong alternative
confidence_scale.low: multiple plausible candidates OR indirect linkage (review papers, theory-shared predictions without shared data) — do not auto-confirm

kind_semantics.test: Publication informs or provides data for this EFCValidation. Proposed edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS]->(EFCValidation)
kind_semantics.gap: Publication bears on resolution of this knowledge gap. Proposed edge: (Publication)-[:INFORMS_GAP]->(Gap). Use BLOCKS_RESOLUTION_OF when publication flags the gap as blocking (per ledger_action).
kind_semantics.framework: Publication represents a competing theoretical framework. Parser multi-labels node as (:Publication:Framework) and creates (Publication)-[:COMPETES_WITH]->(Theory {canonical: 'EFC'}). No test_id needed on this target kind.

graph_status_legend.confirmed: Target node verified present in Neo4j at generation time (test_id matched EFCValidation.test_id)
graph_status_legend.not_found: Target not found in current graph. For gaps this is expected (three canonical gap_ids from watchlist have no counterpart under any label as of 2026-04-18). Parser logs warning and skips edge.
graph_status_legend.not_applicable: Framework kind — target is implicit EFC Theory node, not a specific test/gap identifier

gap_materialization_note.interpretation: The KnowledgeGap label is dominated by conversation-derived hash-ID gaps (gap_meta_*, gap_*). The three canonical gap_ids referenced in watchlist ledger_action (theory-background-hz-modification, theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver, theory-multicomponent-sparc-universality) do not exist in the graph under any label. Recommended next action: create them via docs/validation-ledger/data/ flow as part of the normal ledger-update cycle, NOT as a side-effect of this parser. Parser logs WARN and skips gap edges until they are materialized.

mappings.title: DES Y6 Results: Cosmological Constraints from Galaxy Clustering and Weak Lensing (3×2pt)

targets.reasoning: DES Y6 3×2pt is the primary S8 probe referenced in P3 test.
ADDED v0.2. 3×2pt IS perturbation-sector data (not background). This test explicitly names perturbation-sector localization — exact match for ledger_action's 'perturbation probes' framing.
ADDED v0.2. 3×2pt constrains the joint μ-Σ degeneracy valley (perturbation sector, success-status test). Stronger fit than the 'with_grav' variant given DES Y6 3×2pt measures μ and Σ together.
3×2pt also informs degeneracy-valley viability with gravitational slip, but the 'with_grav' flavor is one step more specific than raw 3×2pt data provides. Kept as medium.
MGCAMB is analytical tool for interpreting 3×2pt; data-tool relationship is indirect but reasonable.
